summary: A Dataset window and a DFM Ratios tab now open with a cell already selected, so the formula bar shows a formula or a value instead of asking you to pick a cell.
details: A Dataset window opens on the first cell holding a formula, read across each row in turn; a table with no formula opens on its first cell.
A Ratios tab opens on the green selected average of the first column, showing its formula when that row is User Entry and its value otherwise.
Once you move or clear the selection yourself, the window leaves it where you put it.
